context: Asuka and Mei discuss a biography and its subject.
purpose: WIDENED SCENARIO: literature chat; biography vocabulary (人物/著/かつ/ファン/入る) in natural home.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: あの伝記の人物、魅力的でしたね。
lines.en: The figure in that biography was fascinating.
lines.style: soft warm woman voice, gentle engaged delivery throughout

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 著者は、人物像を丁寧に描いていますね。
lines.en: The author depicts the figure carefully.
lines.style: composed teacher voice, soft warm reflective clarity throughout

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: その人物は、優しくかつ強かったんですね。
lines.en: That figure was kind yet strong.
lines.style: gentle woman voice, soft warm admiring delivery throughout

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 多くのファンが、彼を慕いました。
lines.en: Many admirers looked up to him.
lines.style: patient teacher voice, soft warm reflective clarity throughout

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 私も、すっかりファンになりました。
lines.en: I've completely become a fan too.
lines.style: warm woman voice, soft warm delighted delivery throughout

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: この著は、彼の日記を基にしています。
lines.en: This work is based on his diary.
lines.style: composed teacher voice, soft warm reflective clarity throughout

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 物語に、すっと入っていけました。
lines.en: I could slip right into the story.
lines.style: soft woman voice, gentle warm delivery throughout

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 人物の心に、深く入れる一冊ですね。
lines.en: It's a book that lets you enter the figure's heart.
lines.style: warm teacher voice, soft warm reflective closing clarity throughout
